Name: Lunar Panda Deluxe
Overview:
The year is 3016 and Pandas are now the dominant species of planet Earth. Amongst this God-like species exists one Panda in particular, known simply as Mr Panda, who left his home planet in search of adventure.

In this revolutionary new video game you take full control of Mr Panda as he negotiates gravity, uneven surfaces and a finite amount of jetpack fuel!
